[[Source of Whispers]] is a Lightbringer Scrivener, a [[historian]] in the Order of Whispers. He hands outs [[storybook]]s for [[Night Falls]] and [[Young Heroes of Tyria]] (both [[normal mode]] and [[hard mode]] versions) and accepts filled storybooks in return for Lightbringer rewards.

==Locations==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Chantry of Secrets}}

==Dialogue==
:''"So now you come to the Source, <player's name>. The Source administers the distribution of reports to our agents in the field. Be sure to carefully document your [[mission]]s against those who would destroy the Light. Bring that written evidence to the Source and as your deeds become known, your reputation will grow within the Order.''
:''"If you increase your reputation enough, you can even earn [[Hero skill point]]s, which can be spent to teach your Heroes new skills from any of the [[Hero skill trainer|Hero Skill Trainers]] in [[Elona]] and beyond."''

:'''I would like that. What was it I needed to do?'''
:''<small>If [[Lightbringer rank]] is 0-4:</small>''
:''"Assist every agent you encounter. We are all battling on the side of Light and should work together in this respect. Only then will we prevail. There are Agents of Whispers scattered throughout the land.''
:''Don't forget to keep a diligent record of your missions in those books you carry. That written evidence is the key to raising your reputation."''

:''<small>If Lightbringer rank is 5-7:</small>'' {{verify|verified on rank 6, presuming 5 starts this dialogue as that's the NM/HM split for the books}}
:''"I think you are going to need to do something a little more to keep gaining reputation with the members of the Order. Try doing all the things you have done before, but this time do them in Hard Mode and then bring me the written evidence You could also bring reports on the Young Heroes of Tyria in Hard Mode."''

:''<small>If Lightbringer rank is 8:</small>''
:''"You are a shining beacon of all the Order stands for. There is not a single agent who does not know your name already."''

:'''Written evidence?'''
:''"Your copy of Night Falls is the best way to track your missions against the forces of [[Abaddon]], but we are also interested in tales of Young Heroes of Tyria in Hard Mode.''
:''"I can provide you with blank copies of either of these books. No doubt there are other books out there to show your prowess and skill, but you'll need to find those on your own."''

:'''I'll be on my way.'''
:''"exit"''

==Notes==
*This NPC was added in the [[Game updates/20081113|13th November 2008 game update]].
